mask.source: Natural Earth 1:10m physical land and river vectors
decisions: Kuma–Manych Depression, NOT main Caucasus crest
Cyprus whole island INCLUDED as explicit project exception
Iceland and Svalbard included; Greenland excluded
Russia split along Ural Mountains and actual Ural river vector
Kazakhstan only west of Ural river; Turkey Eastern Thrace only
mask.accuracy: Versioned scientific pilot convention, NOT an authoritative geological boundary. Ural ridge and Kuma–Manych are hand-curated schematic polylines, approximately 25 km positional uncertainty (not a certified bound); straits schematic ~5 km. Ural river uses Natural Earth 1:10m vertices, not survey accuracy; disconnected source fragments are noded and merged, excluding only microfragments <=0.003 degrees. Ridge-to-river and Caspian-to-Manych joins are schematic. Coastlines 1:10m; islands below source resolution absent. Cyprus selection window contains only Cyprus land. Atlantic western limit 32W: Azores included; Madeira/Canaries excluded. Novaya Zemlya west of eastern Arctic line included; Franz Josef Land may be partitioned by the explicitly archived Arctic line.
mask.license: Natural Earth public domain; project boundary coordinates CC0

method: CMIP6: areacella * (sftlf/100) * area(cell∩European land)/area(cell∩all land); no double land fraction. NASA: geometric area(cell∩same European land). Each monthly mean requires >=90% of fixed target weights; no gap filling. All 12 months required per year. Calendar day weighting for annual, baseline and periods. Own 1981–2010 baseline for each product, not joined.
limitations: ONE MODEL / ONE MEMBER technical pilot, no ensemble, min–max, uncertainty band or robust prediction
GISTEMP250 is station-based land-air reconstruction, sparse early coverage; invalid years null, not zero
Land geography identical; model land fractions differ from coastline. Area differences quantified, not hidden

Ridge-to-river and Caspian-to-Manych joins are schematic. Coastlines 1:10m; islands below source resolution absent. Cyprus selection window contains only Cyprus land.
